elements.requirement: The appropriate Minister may arrange for the inspection from time to time of any premises in which a child is living with a person with whom the child has been placed by an adoption agency.
elements.quote: The appropriate Minister may arrange for any premises in which— (a) a child is living with a person with whom the child has been placed by an adoption agency

elements.requirement: The appropriate Minister may arrange for the inspection from time to time of any premises in which a child in respect of whom a notice of intention to adopt has been given under section 44 is, or will be, living.
elements.quote: a child in respect of whom a notice of intention to adopt has been given under section 44 is, or will be, living, to be inspected from time to time

elements.requirement: The appropriate Minister may require an adoption agency to provide any information specified by the appropriate Minister relating to the discharge of any of its functions in relation to adoption.
elements.quote: The appropriate Minister may require an adoption agency— (a) to give him any information

elements.requirement: The appropriate Minister may require an adoption agency to allow the inspection of any records, in whatever form they are held, relating to the discharge of any of its functions in relation to adoption which the appropriate Minister specifies.
elements.quote: to allow him to inspect any records (in whatever form they are held), relating to the discharge of any of its functions in relation to adoption which the appropriate Minister specifies

elements.requirement: An inspection under section 15 must be conducted by a person authorised by the appropriate Minister.
elements.quote: An inspection under this section must be conducted by a person authorised by the appropriate Minister.

elements.requirement: An officer of a local authority may only be authorised to conduct an inspection under section 15 with the consent of that local authority.
elements.quote: An officer of a local authority may only be so authorised with the consent of the authority.

elements.requirement: A person inspecting premises under subsection (1) may visit the child at those premises.
elements.quote: A person inspecting any premises under subsection (1) may— (a) visit the child there

elements.requirement: A person inspecting premises under subsection (1) may carry out any examination into the state of the premises and the treatment of the child there that the person thinks fit.
elements.quote: make any examination into the state of the premises and the treatment of the child there which he thinks fit

elements.requirement: A person authorised to inspect records under section 15 may, at any reasonable time, have access to, and inspect and check the operation of, any computer and associated apparatus that is being or has been used in connection with the records in question.
elements.quote: A person authorised to inspect any records under this section may at any reasonable time have access to, and inspect and check the operation of, any computer (and associated apparatus) which is being or has been used in connection with the records in question.

elements.requirement: A person authorised to inspect premises or records under section 15 may enter the premises for that purpose at any reasonable time.
elements.quote: enter the premises for that purpose at any reasonable time

elements.requirement: A person authorised to inspect premises or records under section 15 may require any person to provide any reasonable assistance the authorised person may require.
elements.quote: require any person to give him any reasonable assistance he may require

elements.requirement: A person exercising a power under section 15 must produce a duly authenticated document showing their authority if they are required to do so.
elements.quote: A person exercising a power under this section must, if required to do so, produce a duly authenticated document showing his authority.

elements.requirement: Any person who intentionally obstructs another person in the exercise of a power under section 15 commits an offence.
elements.quote: Any person who intentionally obstructs another in the exercise of a power under this section is guilty of an offence

elements.requirement: A person guilty of intentionally obstructing another in the exercise of a power under section 15 is liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale.
elements.quote: liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale

thresholds.what: the maximum fine level on the standard scale on summary conviction for intentionally obstructing the exercise of a power under section 15
thresholds.quote: fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale
